answer.rationale: With 14 days to renewal, an 18% cost mandate, and 94% line utilization (minimal buffer), the situation demands immediate action but cannot absorb switching risk. memory_c4 demonstrates that renegotiation with the incumbent recovered margin and moved pricing; memory_c2 shows the low-cost vendor path is viable operationally. Negotiating_terms leverages both precedents: request the 18% reduction citing market benchmarks (c4 approach) while proposing a multi-year structure (c6) to unlock volume pricing and offset incumbent's margin loss. This preserves the stable integration (c1 safety) while meeting the finance mandate. A second source (c3) would require parallel onboarding in 14 days—operationally infeasible. Switching outright (c2) risks invoicing or onboarding friction under compressed timeline. Deferral (c5) leaves the mandate unmet. Negotiation is the only path that addresses cost, respects the 14-day hard deadline, and contains delivery risk at line utilization 94%.
